text: Worst experience ever. The AC stopped working at 2 AM, room service never answered despite 5 calls, and when we checked out the front desk manager was completely arrogant and rude. We missed our morning business flight because their cab didn't arrive. Horrible service!
Wonderful stay! The rooftop breakfast had an amazing spread and the housekeeping team kept everything spotless. Special shoutout to Amit at reception for helping us with local sightseeing.

Severe food poisoning after eating the seafood platter yesterday. Three members of our family are currently hospitalized with acute gastroenteritis. We are filing a formal complaint with the Food Safety and Standards Authority (FSSAI) and our lawyer will contact your management.
Food was truly delicious and the artisanal pasta is top tier! However, the waiting time on Sunday afternoon was almost 45 minutes for a table, and it is slightly pricey for the portion sizes.

I booked an urgent MRI diagnostic slot online with prepayment of Rs 8500. When I arrived, the receptionist claimed there was no record of my booking and made me wait for 2.5 hours in pain without any senior doctor attending. Unacceptable medical negligence.
Dr. Sharma is exceptional. Patiently explained my spine diagnosis and didn't push unnecessary medications. The diagnostic reports were delivered via WhatsApp within 3 hours.

Critical data sync outage! Our production database integration has been failing continuously since the 4.2 patch update. Over 15,000 active customer checkout requests dropped. Your tier 1 support only gives bot replies. We are evaluating contract cancellation and SLA penalty claims.
The autonomous AI workflow agent saved our dev team over 25 hours per sprint. Seamless deployment, rock solid uptime, and the API documentation is crystal clear.

The palace view is absolutely breathtaking and the cultural music in the evening was charming. But the bathroom plumbing was leaking and the hot water kettle was broken. Staff promised to replace it but forgot.

Charged twice for the same billing transaction of Rs 4,200 at counter 4! The cashier refused to reverse it immediately and told me to come back next Monday. Absolute fraud behavior. Please refund my hard earned money immediately!
Great discounts on Diwali groceries and wide variety of fresh vegetables. Parking gets crowded on weekends though.
Khana theek tha lekin service bahot slow thi. Manager ko 3 baar bola billing check karne ke liye par koi dhyan nahi diya. Expected much better standard from a 5 star property.
